purpose: Read-only product-photo reuse-rights research for 24 assigned product families, followed by authorised download of one individually licensed photograph to restricted local asset staging. No brand outreach, account access, transformation or paid asset purchase.

Beardo.observation: Official footer-linked terms require owner written consent for reproducing proprietary material and reserve the site graphics. Direct web open initially failed, but the actual footer link resolved the complete primary page.
Beardo.request: No public reusable media kit identified by targeted primary-site search. No request was sent.

Plum.observation: Official terms restrict reuse beyond personal non-commercial use without explicit permission and expressly prohibit hotlinking. Brand-store product imagery is not licensed for Glowwise publication.
Plum.request: An explicit written licence identifying image files and scope would be needed for brand photographs. No request was sent.
Plum.section: Ownership of rights; Usage Restrictions; Copyright and Trademark

Minimalist.observation: India footer-linked terms read in the browser; prior written consent required for copying, downloading, reproducing, displaying or reusing site intellectual property. The obsolete /pages/terms-and-conditions page displayed Loading.
Minimalist.request: Media Outreach is a request form, not a public image licence. No request was sent.

alternative_searches.outcome: Domain-restricted search returned unrelated generic minimalist art / Commons user Beardo, no exact assigned product match. Direct Special:MediaSearch was inaccessible through web extraction. This is a searched-evidence gap, not proof that no file exists anywhere.

alternative_searches.method: Unauthenticated official read-only search API, page_size=50, product name/brand/quantity/front-image fields. Search returned 2 Minimalist, 34 Plum and 4 Beardo records; all pages fit returned first page. Exactly one assigned product candidate found. Detailed individual-file licence and image match then verified in normal browser.
alternative_searches.limitations: General photo-licence documentation does not establish an individual image match; the one candidate was checked on its own photo detail page. Database food/cosmetic facts were not imported into Glowwise; existing official product facts remain authoritative. Browser accessible although web search extraction reported robots/NOINDEX.

allowed_image.matched_pack: Actual outer carton: Plum rice water & NIACINAMIDE 2% hybrid sunscreen, SPF 50 PA++++, 50 g. Read directly from browser photograph.
allowed_image.licence_evidence: Photo detail page explicitly labels this individual file CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported.
allowed_image.attribution: Photo by abhi127 per Open Beauty Facts
allowed_image.transformation_requirements: Attribute author and source, link licence, identify any crop/resize/format change, retain CC BY-SA 3.0 for adaptations. Licence covers photograph; do not imply brand endorsement.
allowed_image.quality: Hand-held outer carton, mild perspective and soft focus, cluttered retail background and camera timestamp. Correct pack identity is readable. Faithful crop can remove background; do not reshape/reconstruct packaging or describe it as a studio pack shot. Preserve photographer attribution/CC licence and identify changes.
allowed_image.usage_guard: Use only when the 50 g variant is presented. 30 g and 80 g packs remain unmatched; do not imply the pictured 50 g pack depicts those sizes.
allowed_image.visually_inspected: Downloaded original inspected at 3000x4000 source resolution (viewer preview resized to 1368x1824). Packaging title, 2%, SPF50 PA++++ and 50g are readable. This is an outer carton photographed in a hand, not the exposed tube. No tube-packaging claim.

approximate_carton_body_bounds_original_.limitation: Approximate from visual inspection of scaled preview. Include blue hanging tab extending upward to about y330 if retaining full retail carton; retain packaging proportions.
